verdict.rationale: Docs detail a full flow — purchase-intent mandates as checkout sessions, tokenized/agent-scoped payment credentials tied to authenticated instructions, passkey-based authorization, and real-time payment outcome confirmation — covering all three story elements end-to-end. However, the core product page itself carries the caveat 'This product is in the process of development and deployment,' and there is no independent/hands-on evidence of a completed live purchase, only API/spec documentation. Missing for 10: independent corroboration of a real completed transaction, resolution of the explicit in-development/maturity caveat, and clarity on production availability beyond sandbox.
